args.body:
Dear HR Team,

Please find below a summary of the leave policy LV-4:

- Annual Leave: Employees are entitled to 25 days of paid annual leave per year, pro-rated for part-time employees.
- Sick Leave: Up to 10 days of paid sick leave per year, subject to medical certification for absences longer than 3 days.
- Parental Leave: Eligible employees may take up to 12 weeks of unpaid parental leave for the birth or adoption of a child.
- Bereavement Leave: 5 days of paid leave in the event of the death of an immediate family member.
- Request Process: All leave requests must be submitted at least two weeks in advance via the HR portal.

For further details, please refer to the full policy document LV-4.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]

Northwind Ltd
